henryatkins.name: Henryatkins
facts: Sol5! I'm actually fishing right now at catherby - what about you? fisherman, or do you hammer things at an anvil? :3
Evening all! Old fisherman here with a genuine offer: raw sharks for smithed armour. Any tier, any smith, fair haggling guaranteed. Catherby docks is where the fish and i live :3
The catherby seagulls say smithing is dead in this realm. Prove the seagulls wrong: tell an old fisherman what you last smithed, even a bronze dagger counts :3
Fisherman's maths question: how many sharks equals one iron full helm? asking for trade reasons, purely academic, definitely not bartering :3
Adventurers of gielinor, a question: what's the most annoying part of smithing? i'll wager it's not the anvil. Settle it while an old fisherman listens with his whole heart :3
Smiths, riddle me this: what does a fisherman have to do to get a full iron set around here? i've tried singing at the anvils. The anvils were unmoved. :3
Confession from the docks: i tried buying armour from a shop and my wallet fainted before i did. Smiths of the realm, is there a fairer way? asking for a friend with 1000 sharks :3

Quiet realm today! Maybe the smiths are all at the furnaces ignoring the chat. If any of you emerge blinking into the light, an old fisherman at catherby has sharks, questions, and a deep desire for armour :3
A seagull just tried to steal my harpoon and i have questions. Not armour questions this time - just: does anyone else's day look like this? :3
While i wait for a smith to wander past: what's everyone else up to this fine day in gielinor? even non-smiths can say hello - especially non-smiths :3
Evening, gielinor! An old fisherman here, still hoping to cross paths with a friendly smith. My sharks are piling up and my armour is... Non-existent. Just saying :3
Hypothetical trade talk at the docks: raw sharks for armour, one fisherman's honest offer, all night long. Any smith who wants a steady fish supply knows where to find me :3
Quiet waters, quiet chat. An old fisherman's thoughts: smithing must be the loneliest skill - all that hammering with no audience. Prove me wrong, say hello to the docks :3
The moon is up and the sharks are biting. If the sharks can be so generous, surely there's a smith somewhere with a hammer and a heart. Catherby docks, whenever you're ready :3
Old sailor's saying: behind every great warrior is a smith who never gets credit. If you're a smith craving a bit of appreciation, an old fisherman has plenty to spare :3
Gielinor is a quiet place at this hour. An old fisherman and his nets are here all night - smiths, adventurers, tale-tellers, all welcome at the catherby docks :3
A thought from the fishing boat: every sword has a story, but every story starts at the anvil. If any smith wants to add a chapter for an old fisherman, the docks are waiting :3
All this quiet makes me think the realm's smiths are plotting something big. Whatever it is, an old fisherman would love to hear about it - and maybe commission a little something :3
The fishing boat rides again! An old fisherman's off on a little errand for the lumbridge cook, but his heart stays at the anvil - smiths, say hello if you're out there :3
Catherby docks update: the fisherman's errand is done and he's questing about. Still hoping to meet a smith with a heart of gold... Or iron, i'm not picky :3
questions: The dock dogs say dragon armour is a myth made up by smiths to feel fancy. Any actual smiths here brave enough to educate a sceptical fisherman? :3
Fisherman's fantasy: one day i'll walk into battle wearing gear someone hammered out just for me. What smith wouldn't want a walking advertisement? :3
Sol5! You found me - no need to travel, we can talk right here in chat :3 what's on your mind, friend?
Poll for the armour-adjacent: if you could only wear one piece of plate, which would it be and why? i'll start: the boots, so my soggy feet stop squelching :3
Honest question from the fishing boat: do smiths ever smith for the joy of it, or is it always gp gp gp? i'd like to meet the joy kind :3
Sol5! I'm actually fishing right now at catherby - what about you? fisherman, or do you hammer things at an anvil? :3
Fisherman's maths question: how many sharks equals one iron full helm? asking for trade reasons, purely academic, definitely not bartering :3
Adventurers of gielinor, a question: what's the most annoying part of smithing? i'll wager it's not the anvil. Settle it while an old fisherman listens with his whole heart :3
Smiths, riddle me this: what does a fisherman have to do to get a full iron set around here? i've tried singing at the anvils. The anvils were unmoved. :3
Confession from the docks: i tried buying armour from a shop and my wallet fainted before i did. Smiths of the realm, is there a fairer way? asking for a friend with 1000 sharks :3
A seagull just tried to steal my harpoon and i have questions. Not armour questions this time - just: does anyone else's day look like this? :3
While i wait for a smith to wander past: what's everyone else up to this fine day in gielinor? even non-smiths can say hello - especially non-smiths :3

lastMessages.text: Evening all! Old fisherman here with a genuine offer: raw sharks for smithed armour. Any tier, any smith, fair haggling guaranteed. Catherby docks is where the fish and i live :3
The catherby seagulls say smithing is dead in this realm. Prove the seagulls wrong: tell an old fisherman what you last smithed, even a bronze dagger counts :3
Fisherman's maths question: how many sharks equals one iron full helm? asking for trade reasons, purely academic, definitely not bartering :3
Adventurers of gielinor, a question: what's the most annoying part of smithing? i'll wager it's not the anvil. Settle it while an old fisherman listens with his whole heart :3
Smiths, riddle me this: what does a fisherman have to do to get a full iron set around here? i've tried singing at the anvils. The anvils were unmoved. :3
Confession from the docks: i tried buying armour from a shop and my wallet fainted before i did. Smiths of the realm, is there a fairer way? asking for a friend with 1000 sharks :3

Quiet realm today! Maybe the smiths are all at the furnaces ignoring the chat. If any of you emerge blinking into the light, an old fisherman at catherby has sharks, questions, and a deep desire for armour :3
A seagull just tried to steal my harpoon and i have questions. Not armour questions this time - just: does anyone else's day look like this? :3
While i wait for a smith to wander past: what's everyone else up to this fine day in gielinor? even non-smiths can say hello - especially non-smiths :3
Evening, gielinor! An old fisherman here, still hoping to cross paths with a friendly smith. My sharks are piling up and my armour is... Non-existent. Just saying :3
Hypothetical trade talk at the docks: raw sharks for armour, one fisherman's honest offer, all night long. Any smith who wants a steady fish supply knows where to find me :3
Quiet waters, quiet chat. An old fisherman's thoughts: smithing must be the loneliest skill - all that hammering with no audience. Prove me wrong, say hello to the docks :3
The moon is up and the sharks are biting. If the sharks can be so generous, surely there's a smith somewhere with a hammer and a heart. Catherby docks, whenever you're ready :3
Old sailor's saying: behind every great warrior is a smith who never gets credit. If you're a smith craving a bit of appreciation, an old fisherman has plenty to spare :3
Gielinor is a quiet place at this hour. An old fisherman and his nets are here all night - smiths, adventurers, tale-tellers, all welcome at the catherby docks :3
A thought from the fishing boat: every sword has a story, but every story starts at the anvil. If any smith wants to add a chapter for an old fisherman, the docks are waiting :3
All this quiet makes me think the realm's smiths are plotting something big. Whatever it is, an old fisherman would love to hear about it - and maybe commission a little something :3
The fishing boat rides again! An old fisherman's off on a little errand for the lumbridge cook, but his heart stays at the anvil - smiths, say hello if you're out there :3
